items.quote: Q4 FY26 will be better, but Q1 FY27 will be better still.
items.statement: Performance to improve in Q4FY26 vs Q3FY26 and further in Q1FY27
items.speaker: Maulik Mehta

items.quote: we are expecting to run at 100% or close enough to 100% utilization from this quarter onwards
items.statement: Run nitration, hydrogenation and nitric acid assets at about 100% utilisation from Q4FY26
items.speaker: Maulik Mehta

items.quote: When we talk about MIBK, it will have a ramp-up in Q1 FY27 in a phased manner
items.statement: MIBK capacity to ramp up in Q1FY27 in phases
items.speaker: Maulik Mehta

items.quote: which will come in around between June and July 2026
items.statement: High-pressure alkylation asset to come online June-July 2026, completing Phase 1 of investments
items.speaker: Maulik Mehta

items.quote: INR 2,500 crore is for FY27, not FY26.
items.statement: Capex of about INR 2,500 crore planned for FY27
items.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay

items.quote: bringing the total to approximately INR 1,200–1,300 crore
items.statement: Total capex of about INR 1,200-1,300 crore in FY26
items.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay

items.quote: this will come online in Q1 FY27
items.statement: BTC to BTF (or equivalent) product capacity online in Q1FY27
items.speaker: Maulik Mehta

tone.label: cautious
tone.why: Management says it is cautiously optimistic and calls the coming quarter volatile and hard to predict, while expecting gradual improvement from Q4FY26.
